blind_protocol: Label every remaining Minus Two and Pine Valley terminal impact and contact (and near passes within 1 m) from video, telemetry and hindsight maps BEFORE any model or baseline output on the event is seen. Record blind=true, labeller and labelled_at. Oracle-route flights get oracle_route=true and are excluded from evaluation sets. The 15 curated lateral-study impacts stay in the lateral manifest and are merged by the label builder.
